basic.name: Thorns of the Abyss
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Luocha's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Prayer of Abyss Flower
skill.description_template: After using his Skill, Luocha immediately restores the target ally's HP equal to {{healing_atk}}% of Luocha's ATK plus {{healing_flat}}. When any ally's HP percentage drops to 50% or lower, an effect equivalent to Luocha's Skill will immediately be triggered and applied to this ally for one time (without consuming Skill Points). This effect can be triggered again after 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Death  Wish
ultimate.description_template: Removes 1 buff(s) from all enemies and deals all enemies Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Luocha's ATK. At the same time, Luocha gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.

talent.name: Cycle of Life
talent.description_template: When Abyss Flower reaches 2 stacks, Luocha consumes all stacks of Abyss Flower to deploy a Zone against the enemy. When any enemy in the Zone is attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is immediately restored by an amount equal to {{healing_atk}}% of Luocha's ATK plus {{healing_flat}}. The Zone's effect lasts for 2 turns. When Luocha is knocked down, the Zone will be dispelled.

technique.name: Mercy of a Fool
technique.description: After the Technique is used, the Talent will be immediately triggered at the start of the next battle.

2.name: Cleansing Revival
2.description: When Skill's effect is triggered, dispel 1 debuff(s) from one designated ally.

4.name: Sanctified
4.description: When any enemy in the Zone is attacked by an ally, all allies (except the attacker) restore HP equal to 7% of Luocha's ATK plus 93.

6.name: Through the Valley
6.description: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 70%.

eidolons.name: Ablution of the Quick
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, ATK of all allies increases by 20%.

eidolons.name: Bestowal From the Pure
eidolons.description: When his Skill is triggered, if the target ally's HP percentage is lower than 50%, Luocha's Outgoing Healing increases by 30%. If the target ally's HP percentage is at 50% or higher, the ally receives a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 18% of Luocha's ATK plus 240, lasting for 2 turns.

eidolons.name: Surveyal by the Fool
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Heavy Lies the Crown
eidolons.description: When Luocha's Zone is active, enemies become Weakened and deal 12% less DMG.

eidolons.name: Cicatrix 'Neath the Pain
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Reunion With the Dust
eidolons.description: When Ultimate is used, there is a 100% fixed chance to reduce all enemies' All-Type RES by 20% for 2 turn(s).
